digest.component_or_area: LLM model class resolution and verifier model selection
propositions: Multiple independent code paths select the verifier model and all three incorrectly downgrade to the default only on exact string match, causing provider-qualified or non-default models to escape the downgrade and run on the frontier model instead

Code-review's verify step declares no model key and falls through to cfg.model (frontier) rather than resolving the standard class, leaving Pass-2 on the frontier model even when standard class is configured for a different provider

The equality test comparing cfg.model to DEFAULT_MODEL fails when cfg.model is provider-qualified (e.g. anthropic:claude-opus-4-8 vs bare claude-opus-4-8), silently keeping the verifier on the frontier model in those cases

Resolution of reserved class names (trivial/standard/frontier) must be centralized in a single resolve_model_string() function and called from multiple independent verifier and ladder code paths rather than duplicated
The verify step temperature: 0 setting for greedy Pass-2 determinism has never taken effect because the step runs on the frontier model where pydantic-ai silently drops temperature

All three verifier paths (plan-review _verifier_cfg, completion equality test, code-review verify step) must resolve the standard class regardless of cfg.model value or provider qualification to prevent silent inheritance of the frontier model across provider cutover
